In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s. At 13.2 s cut to a top-down creek: brown water band across the middle between pale wavy banks, round oak crowns on olive ground. A white car seen from above sits at the right against the lower bank; its pale roof glass shows a round wheel shape and two dark seat blocks. Several long pale stripes run along the water, one passing just above the car. A pale slab with a few small dot bubbles sits at the upper-left bank and small dot bubbles show at the car's right end. Caption sits just below the car, above the lower trees.
